issues.title: As a player I wish to be able to delete orders
issues.body:
I've entered a set of orders, but now I wish to cancel them.

Note: since it's not easy to add an `Archive` button into JSON Editor, I've changed the approach. Now umpire staff are able to archive orders documents.

The functionality is implemented in #2419 , but the implementation of `archiveConfirmed` needs to be finished off, to send the modified messages to the database.

To reflect the "time-travelling" aspect of Serge, we won't delete the document, we'll mark it as cancelled, using the existing `archived` flag in `MessageDetails`.  The client-side will not display cancelled orders. Note: we can't just strip out the cancelled versions of orders, since we would then just display the previous version of the orders.  We need to filter the orders in `PlanningChannel`.

issues.title: Only need "persistent rows" workaround if a document is being edited.
issues.body:
@lilitkarapetyan developed this workaround that prevents `live` json-editor documents being wiped when new messages are received.

But, I realise that we only need to apply that workaround if there is currently a `detail` panel open, and it contains a JSON-editor document that is being edited.

The workaround itself may be an issue - since it doesn't handle multiple new documents, document state changing, maybe other scenarios.

So, we should only apply the workaround (in planning-messages and adjudication-messages) if we know a document is currently being edited.
